title: Domain Glossary Configuration
description: Vocabulary of the world the game is set in (the supermarket chain and how it runs), highlighted in the same places as the MLOps glossary but underlined differently so a player can tell the two apart.

enabled.title: Enable Glossary Highlighting
enabled.description: Master switch. When off, all game text renders unchanged.

case_sensitive.title: Case Sensitive Matching
case_sensitive.description: When off (recommended), 'Data Drift' and 'data drift' both match.

match_whole_words.title: Match Whole Words Only
match_whole_words.description: When on (recommended), 'feature' does not match inside 'features store'.

max_highlights_per_term_per_block.title: Max Highlights Per Term Per Text Block
max_highlights_per_term_per_block.description: How often the same term is highlighted within one message or note. 1 keeps text readable; 0 means unlimited.

min_term_length.title: Minimum Term Length
min_term_length.description: Terms and aliases shorter than this are ignored, which stops very short strings from peppering the text.

surfaces.title: Where Highlighting Applies
surfaces.description: Turn highlighting on or off per surface of the game.

speech_bubbles.title: Pitch Debate Speech Bubbles
speech_bubbles.description: Off by default: those bubbles are click-to-skip and disappear on a timer, so hovering them fights the interaction.

action_proposal.title: Compose Action Proposal
action_proposal.description: The proposal inspector: component names and the explanations of what is holding a component back.

underline_style.title: Underline Style
underline_style.description: How a term of this glossary is underlined. This is what tells a player which vocabulary they are looking at: dotted for the MLOps practice, wavy for the world the game is set in.

categories.title: Term Categories
categories.description: Grouping used for the colour of the underline and the label on the hover card.

id.title: Term ID
id.description: Stable, unique identifier. Used as the React key and in the highlight markup.

term.title: Term
term.description: The canonical spelling, shown as the heading of the hover card.

aliases.title: Aliases & Inflections
aliases.description: Other spellings that should highlight to this same explanation (plurals, abbreviations, British/American spellings).

category.title: Category
category.description: Must match one of the category IDs above.

definition.title: Definition
definition.description: One or two sentences of plain language. Shown as the body of the hover card.

why_it_matters.title: Why It Matters Here
why_it_matters.description: Optional second paragraph tying the term to this game's stakeholders and challenges.

read_more.title: Read More URL
read_more.description: Optional link shown at the foot of the hover card.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: Keep the entry but stop highlighting it.

kind.title: Glossary Kind
kind.description: Which vocabulary this file holds. Also decides the order the client compiles them in, which settles any spelling both glossaries claim.
